overview: Licenses and subscriptions REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.keywords: licenses,subscriptions,cloud volumes ontap licenses,capacity licenses,license expiration,node licenses
ai-gen.lead: Manage the licenses for Cloud Volumes ONTAP and the subscriptions to other NetApp Console services. Use these endpoints to view node, capacity, and data services licenses and to monitor their expiration and capacity usage.

x-doc.title: Associate a license

ai-gen.lead: Creates an association between a license and the NetApp Console by specifying either a NetApp License File (NLF) or required fields such as `serialNumber` and `nssKeyId`. Use this endpoint to manage licenses for NetApp Console services based on your account or resource requirements.
ai-gen.keywords: license association,netapp console,serial number,license file,license type,expiration date

x-doc.title: Update a license by serial number

ai-gen.lead: Updates a specified license by license serial number. Use this endpoint to modify license details, either by providing a NetApp License File (NLF) or by specifying individual fields to update.
ai-gen.keywords: license update,serial number,netapp license,file overwrite,license metadata

x-doc.title: Delete a license

ai-gen.lead: Deletes a license by using a specified serial number. Use this endpoint to remove licenses that are no longer needed or valid.
ai-gen.keywords: license deletion,serial number,license removal,delete license by serial number

x-doc.title: Retrieve a license by type

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves a specified license by type, resource ID, or both. Use this endpoint to access license details, including consumed capacity and summary information for data services when applicable.
ai-gen.keywords: license retrieval,license type,resource id,capacity usage,netapp license file

x-doc.title: Update a license by resource ID

ai-gen.lead: Updates a specified license by resource ID. Use this to modify license details for a particular resource in the NetApp Console service.
ai-gen.keywords: license update,license resource,resource id,account license,netapp license

x-doc.title: Delete a license by resource ID

ai-gen.lead: Deletes a specified license by its resource ID. Use this to remove licenses that are no longer needed or applicable.
ai-gen.keywords: license delete,remove license,license resource,delete license resource,account license

x-doc.title: Exchange a Cloud Volumes ONTAP license

ai-gen.lead: Exchanges an unused Cloud Volumes ONTAP license for a data service license. Use this endpoint to transition your license allocation to support specific data service needs.
ai-gen.keywords: cloud volume,ontap license,data service license,license exchange,account administrator

x-doc.title: Retrieve data service eligibility details

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves data service eligibility details to determine whether an account is eligible to use a data service in an on-premises or cloud environment. Use this to identify licensing and feature requirements for specific configurations based on the provided account and service parameters.
ai-gen.keywords: data service eligibility,license details,on-premises ontap,cloud volumes ontap,storagegrid backup

x-doc.title: Register a subscription

ai-gen.lead: Registers a subscription with the NetApp Console, associating it with an account using the identity and access management service. Use this to manage subscriptions across multiple accounts efficiently.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription registration,identity management,expiration date update,netapp console,account association

x-doc.title: Retrieve all subscriptions for an account

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves all subscriptions for an account, providing subscription details based on the account and optional criteria such as subscription ID or type. Use this to review or manage subscriptions associated with a specific account.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription information,subscription details,account subscriptions,subscription type,netapp license,service scope

x-doc.title: Update a subscription expiration date using the subscription ID

ai-gen.lead: Updates a subscription expiration date using the specified subscription ID. You can use this endpoint to modify the subscription expiry date or update the subscription name for supported services.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription expiration,update subscription,subscription name,modify subscription,expiration date,service subscription

x-doc.title: Delete a subscription using the subscription ID

ai-gen.lead: Deletes a subscription identified by the subscription ID. Use this to remove a subscription from an account or disassociate it when multiple accounts are linked to the subscription.
ai-gen.keywords: delete subscription,cloud volumes,account subscription,disassociate subscription,subscription removal,netapp console

x-doc.title: Retrieve on-prem ONTAP data

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves on-premises ONTAP cluster data, including configuration details such as the cluster management IP address, capacity, contract date, and feature licenses. Use this endpoint to access telemetry and configuration data from clusters configured for AutoSupport.
ai-gen.keywords: ontap cluster,on-premises ontap,cluster configuration,cluster management,feature licenses

x-doc.title: Retrieve the subscription entitlements

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves subscription entitlement information for a specified service name. Use this to access details about authorized service calls within predefined scopes.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription entitlements,service subscriptions,entitlement details,service entitlements,subscription information

x-doc.title: Retrieve subscription information for an account

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves subscription information for a specified account. Use this to view entitlements or filter subscriptions by service name, depending on the parameters provided.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription information,account subscriptions,subscription entitlements,service subscriptions,cloud provider subscriptions

x-doc.title: Delete a subscription using the account ID

ai-gen.lead: Deletes a subscription associated with the specified account ID. Use this to remove or disassociate subscriptions that meet the required conditions.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription delete,remove subscription,disassociate subscription,cloud volumes ontap,account subscription,subscription management

x-doc.title: Associate a subscription

ai-gen.lead: Associates a subscription with an identity and access management service account. Use this to manage access permissions for multiple accounts linked to a subscription.
ai-gen.keywords: subscription management,identity service,access account,associate subscription,multiple accounts

ai-gen.keywords: subscription information,deprecated endpoint,license subscriptions,subscription id,netapp console

ai-gen.keywords: subscription update,subscription expiration,modify subscription,expiration date update,subscription name change
